---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature, algorithm enhancement, or platform integration
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "proposal"]
---

### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what the feature should accomplish.

### Use Case & Problem Statement
Explain why this feature is valuable. What current pain point or limitation does it address?

### Proposed Solution & Architecture
Describe the proposed implementation, affected modules, or API contracts.
- Subsystems touched:
- New dependencies (if any):
- Impact on ARM64 mobile execution:

### Alternative Approaches Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Automated tests covering new behavior
- [ ] No regression in mobile render speed (<60s on Exynos 1480)
- [ ] Documentation updated in `docs/`
